May 3, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Murphy Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Costco Wholesale (COST) by 51.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Murphy Capital Management Inc sold 3,186 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 2,985 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $555,000, down from 6,171 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Murphy Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Costco Wholesale for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $85.13 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.30% or $2.55 $194. About 1.87 million shares traded. Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) has risen 14.69% uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.14% the S&P500.
